name: comp-480
blurb: Table with columns pinnable to left or right edges.
description: Data table where columns can be pinned to the left or right side via dropdown menu controls. Pinned columns remain visible during horizontal scroll with sticky positioning and subtle backdrop blur separation.
use_when: Wide tables where users need to keep certain columns (like ID or name) visible while scrolling horizontally.
avoid_when: On narrow viewports — pinning reduces horizontal space quickly.
a11y: Pin controls have aria-labels describing the column name. Keyboard accessible through dropdown menus.
